infoLinks.urlText: School bus service changes for Medowie and surrounds
infoLinks.content:

infoLinks.urlText: Millers Point diversions during Vivid Sydney
infoLinks.content:
During Vivid Sydney from Friday 22 May to Saturday 13 June, route 311 buses will use different stops due to road closures on Friday nights and weekends. 
 
Route 311 buses will continue along Hickson Rd to Walsh Bay, and will not travel via Dalgety Rd, Towns Place, Argyle Pl or Argyle St at the following times: 
  • Mondays to Fridays and Sundays (including Mon 8 Jun) from 3pm to 12am 
  • Saturdays and Sunday 7 June from 3pm to 1am 
Buses to and from Millers Point will make additional stops on Hickson Rd at the Walsh Bay Arts precinct. Continue on foot towards Towns Place or Argyle Place. 
 
Allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for the alternative stop locations.  
 
Visit the Vivid Sydney event page for more transport details. 
 
Missed stops: 
  • Towns Pl, after Hickson Rd (2000154) 
  • Argyle Place at lower Fort St (2000100) 
  • Argyle St at Watson Rd (200098) 
  • Argyle St at Kent St (200099)

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD diversions during Vivid Sydney
infoLinks.content:
During Vivid Sydney from Friday 22 May to Saturday 13 June, buses will use different stops due to road closures. 
 
On Saturdays and Sunday of the long weekend (7 June), from 5pm to 1am, buses will start and end trips on York St at Wynyard Station instead of Bridge St. Stops on Bridge St will be missed. 
 
Buses to the city will continue over the Sydney Harbour Bridge instead of the Cahill Expressway Overpass and end trips on York St at Wynyard Station.  
 
Routes 202, 207 and 208 buses leaving the city will start trips from Stand K on York St (200033) at Wynyard Station. Route 263 buses leaving the city will start trips from Stand L on York St (200034) at Wynyard Station. Buses will then travel via Clarence St towards the Sydney Harbour Bridge to resume normal route. 
 
Allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for the alternative stop locations. Visit the Vivid Sydney event page for more details on transport services during the event. 
 
Missed stops: 
  • Bridge St at Gresham St (200096) 
  • Burns Philp Building, Bridge St (2000417) 
  • Exchange Square, Bridge St (2000148)

infoLinks.urlText: T1 North Shore Line: Buses replace trains between Hornsby and Milsons Point. Use metro between Chatswood and the City
infoLinks.content:
Monday 1 and Tuesday 2 June
  • Nightly from 9.20pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains from Hornsby to Milsons Point.
  • Nightly from 10pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains from Milsons Point to Hornsby.
  • Use metro services between Chatswood and the City. Replacement buses also stop at Crows Nest and Victoria Cross metro stations.
  • T9 Northern Line trains run between Berowra or Hornsby and Central, platforms 1-14.
  • Some late-night buses run between T1 North Shore Line stations and Wynyard.

  • The last train from Hornsby to the City leaves Hornsby at 21:12, arriving Wynyard at 21:55.
  • The last train to Hornsby leaves Wynyard at 21:52, arriving Hornsby at 22:34.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
97T1 Chatswood, all stations to Milsons Point (including Crows Nest and Victoria Cross metro stations)
and return (late-night services extend to Wynyard)
98T1 Hornsby, all stations to Chatswood and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

  • Buses replace trains between Richmond and Blacktown.
  • Trains run between Blacktown and Liverpool or Leppington, to a changed timetable.

  • Monday from 2pm to 9pm, trains run to a changed timetable between Blacktown and the City, and between Liverpool and Olympic Park.
  • You may need to change trains at Granville to continue your journey.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.

  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.

  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Ferries will be busy during Vivid Sydney
infoLinks.content:
Ferry passengers are advised to expect delays and long queues for ferries to and from the city during Vivid Sydney from Friday 22 May to Saturday 13 June. Services will be busy and are expected to reach capacity from mid-afternoon, particularly on weekends. Some additional F3 and F4 ferries will run on weeknights and weekends during the event. 
 
Vivid Sydney attendees planning to catch a ferry to precincts around Circular Quay, Barangaroo or Pyrmont should plan ahead and have a back-up transport option in mind, from most wharves you can catch buses to the city or to nearby train stations to connect with services to the city.  
 
Visit the Vivid Sydney event page for more details on transport services during the event.

infoLinks.urlText: New school bus services for students from Calderwood and surrounds
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 20 April, three new school routes will be introduced to serve the Calderwood catchment and surrounds.

New routes:
  • S269 – Calderwood to St Josephs HS
  • S270 – Calderwood to Albion Park HS
  • S271 – Calderwood to Shellharbour Anglican College
These routes will be operated by Premier Illawarra and will service St Joseph’s Catholic High School, Albion Park High School and Shellharbour Anglican College.
 
Morning AM services
  • S269 – Bus will commence on Escarpment Drive at 07:38 and arrive at St
    Joseph’s at 07:48.
  • S270 – Bus will commence on Escarpment Drive at 07:58 and arrive
    at Albion Park HS at 08:09.
  • S271 – Bus will commence on Escarpment Drive at 08:20 and arrive at
    Shellharbour Anglican College at 08:50.
Afternoon PM services
  • S270 – Bus will depart Albion Park HS at 14:40 arriving at Escarpment
    Drive at 14:50.
  • S269 – Bus will depart St Joseph’s HS at 15:00 arriving at Escarpment
    Drive at 15:13.
  • S271 – Bus will depart Shellharbour Anglican College at 15:40 arriving at
    Escarpment Drive at 16:17.
Use the Trip Planner to plan your new trip.

From Sunday 24 May to Wednesday 10 June, ferries will not run to or from Pyrmont Bay wharf from 7pm to 7.45pm and 9pm to 9.45pm on Sunday to Wednesday drone show nights (excluding Sunday 7 June). Delay your trip or use alternative transport including light rail or local buses.

From Monday 26 May, students travelling in the morning from the Rutherford and Aberglasslyn areas to Rutherford Technology High School are to use the 2712 service (operated by CDC NSW), instead of the S520 service (operated by Grace Coaches).

What's changing:
  • There is a slight timetable difference between the S520 and 2712, so please check TripPlanner to plan your journey.
  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.
  • Afternoon travel is not affected.

  • Plan your trip and check timetables before you travel.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Leppington and Glenfield
infoLinks.content:
Monday 25 and Tuesday 26 May   
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Leppington and Glenfield.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Macarthur, Glenfield and the City via Granville.
  • Buses also replace T8 Airport & South Line trains between Glenfield, Sydenham and Central via the Airport.

Bus route
9T2 Leppington, Edmondson Park, Glenfield and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Lilyfield Light Rail lift is not available from 9 June
infoLinks.content:
• The lift at Lilyfield Light Rail stop will be out of service from 9 June until further notice while replacement works are carried out. The outage is expected to continue for at least five weeks.
  • During this period, access to the light rail stop will be available only via stairs, if you are able to do so safely.
  • Customer requiring lift access should use the nearest accessible light rail stop at Leichhardt North.
  • To get to Leichardt North stop, from the Lilyfield stop, take the local 437 bus route from the Balmain Rd after Lilyfield Rd stop, exit at the Norton St after City West Link stop and walk to the Leichhardt North light rail stop to catch the light rail.
  • Please allow extra travel time and plan ahead, using the Trip Planner and checking travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.

infoLinks.urlText: L2 and L3 partial line closures during Vivid Sydney on Fridays and weekends
infoLinks.content:
From Friday 22 May to Saturday 13 June, due to road closures and for pedestrian safety during Vivid Sydney, L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford light rail services will not run between Circular Quay and Town Hall during the following times: 
  • On Fridays from 6pm to 1am, and  
  • On Saturdays, Sundays, and public holiday Monday 8 June, from 5pm to 1am.  
Light rail services will continue to run between Town Hall and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford during these times.

If you are travelling to Circular Quay, continue on foot from Town Hall or change for trains. 
Note on Saturdays and on Sunday 7 June from 6pm to 11pm, Sydney Trains services will not drop off passengers at Circular Quay Station – use Wynyard, Martin Place or St James stations instead. 
 
On Sundays to Wednesdays from 7pm to 10pm additional L1 Dulwich Hill Line light rail services will also run.
 
Allow extra travel time as services will be very busy. Visit the Vivid Sydney event page for more details on transport services during the event.

infoLinks.content:
During Vivid Sydney from Friday 22 May to Saturday 13 June route 304, 333, 343, 396 and 392N buses will use different stops due to road closures on Friday nights and weekends. 
 
Buses that usually run to and from Circular Quay will start and end trips at Martin Place instead at the following times: 
  • Fridays from 6pm to midnight  
  • Saturdays and long weekend Sunday (7 Jun) from 5pm to 1am  
  • Sundays and Monday public holiday (8 Jun) from 5pm to midnight 
Buses towards Circular Quay will end trips at Martin Place Elizabeth St, Stand C (2000421). Buses leaving the city will start trips from Martin Place Station, Elizabeth St, Stand E Sydney (2000283) instead of Circular Quay.  
 
Catch trains or continue on foot to travel between Martin Place and Circular Quay during these times. Allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for the alternative stop locations.  
 
Visit the Vivid Sydney event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: Parramatta Rd - Burwood, permanent bus stop closures
infoLinks.content:
Sydney Metro West construction work at Burwood will permanently close the following bus stops:
 
From 4am Monday, 4 April 2022
  • Parramatta Rd before Burwood Rd (213412) will be closed.
    The alternative stop for 415, 461X, 461N and 530 services will be Burwood Rd at Esher Lane (213431).
  • Parramatta Rd after Burwood Rd (213722) will be closed.
    The alternative stop for 415, 416X, 461N and 530 services will be Burwood Rd before Parramatta Rd (213462).

From 6am Monday 4 April 2022:
  • Parramatta Rd before Burwood Rd (213412) will be closed.
    Customers for the N70, N71, N80 and N81 services should use the new stop on Parramatta Rd, after Burwood Rd (213460).
  • Parramatta Rd after Burwood Rd (213722) will be closed.
    Customers for the N70, N71, N80 and N81 towards City Town Hall should use the alternate stop on Parramatta Rd opp Neichs Pde (213721).

infoLinks.urlText: Changes to school bus services impacted by Waterfall Way closure
infoLinks.content:
Some school buses are not running due to the closure of Waterfall Way west of Bellingen due to a landslip.  
As an interim solution for school students in the Dorrigo and Bellingen area, a fleet of minibuses will operate school services via the detour on Summervilles Road.
From Monday 9 February, a phased approach has commenced for school bus services. Families should stay abreast of communication being distributed via their schools.
Sign up for SMS updates about interim bus service cancellations
Inclement weather and road conditions have the potential to prevent interim bus movements on the detour route and cancel services.
Transport has set up an SMS service to notify families of cancellations of services. Opt in to receive SMS via this link.
Routes affected:
  • S110
  • S125
  • S126
  • S127
  • S887

infoLinks.urlText: Station Update - Bardwell Park
infoLinks.content:

Allow extra time to safely cross the road at the signalised pedestrian crossing at the corner of Hartill-Law Avenue and Slade Road.

Please also note that there are no public toilets available at this station until further notice.

infoLinks.urlText: Changes to school bus services in Lithgow
infoLinks.content:
There are timetable changes to school transport services impacted by the closure of the Great Western Highway at Victoria Pass. Changes should reduce travel time for the majority of students.  
  • Some students may have different times for their bus service or a slightly longer walk to their bus stop. 
  • Some students attending Blue Mountains Grammar will travel in the mornings by bus from Hartley Vale to Lithgow train station and transfer to a train to Wentworth Falls. 
  • Some students attending Blue Mountains Grammar will travel in the mornings by train from Blackheath station to Wentworth Falls station.  
  • Journey times are subject to traffic volumes. 
  • Check the Trip Planner for the latest.

infoLinks.urlText: Erskine St/King Street Wharf diversions during Vivid Sydney
infoLinks.content:
During Vivid Sydney from Friday 22 May to Saturday 13 June, route 288, 290 and 292 buses will use different stops due to road closures and expected heavy traffic. 
  • On Saturdays and Sunday of the long weekend (7 June), from 5pm to 1am, buses will start and end trips at Wynyard Station instead of Sussex St near Erskine St. 
  • Buses to the city will end trips at Wynyard Station on York St.  
  • Buses leaving the city will start trips from Stand R (2000142) on Clarence St at Wynyard Station, near Margaret St.  
  • Continue on foot from Wynyard via the underground Wynyard Walk to reach the King St Wharf or Barangaroo precincts. Allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for the alternative stop locations.  
  • Visit the Vivid Sydney event page for more transport details. 
Missed stops: 
  • Sussex St before Erskine St (200018) 
  • Sussex St at Erskine St (200013) 
  • Clarence St opp Barrack St (2000189)

infoLinks.urlText: Brooklyn Ferry Wharf closure
infoLinks.content:
Hornsby Shire Council will be upgrading the Brooklyn Ferry Wharf starting Tuesday 28 April. There will be no access to the Wharf for the Brooklyn Ferry Services and services will be suspended from Tuesday 28 April until Sunday 24 May.
 
Council is providing a Water Taxi service and is expected to operate on the same existing Ferry timetable, however customers are advised to contact Hornsby Shire Council on 02 9847 6071 for any queries regarding the project and to contact the local water taxi provider on 0427 890 177 to confirm the Water Taxi arrangements.
 
TfNSW apologies for any inconvenience caused to our customers during the upgrade of the Brooklyn Ferry Wharf and will confirm the reopening date upon confirmation from Council.
 
Brooklyn Ferry services will resume from Monday 25 May.

  • From 9.40pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Liverpool and Lidcombe.
  • Trains run between Lidcombe and the City, to a changed timetable. You may need to change trains to continue your journey.
  • Buses also replace T2 Leppington & Inner West Line trains between Leppington and Fairfield, and T6 Lidcombe & Bankstown Line trains between Bankstown and Lidcombe.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes

8T6 Bankstown, all stations to Lidcombe and return​
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Station Update - Macquarie Fields
infoLinks.content:
Station Access Changes
From Tuesday 26 August 2025 until mid-2026, the pedestrian ramp access from Railway Parade into the station on Platform 2 will be closed for upgrade works.
During this time, station access will be available via the stairs only.
Planned Trackwork buses depart from Atchinson Rd near the Service Station.
If you require ramp or lift access, please visit transportnsw.info for your accessible travel options.
For more information about the project, please contact the Project Infoline on 1800 684 490 or visit www.transport.nsw.gov.au/macquariefields.
